## Description

A filamentous green alga of cylindrical cells (~60 × 30 µm) joined end to end, with a helical ribbon
chloroplast. It grows by intercalary division and fragments; it forms mats that give refuge. With
nitrogen limiting, two filaments of different types lying side by side form tubes between facing
cells: the content of one passes to the other and a zygospore remains.

## In the simulation

<!-- GENERATED:presence -->
Drops: `pond` (weight 0.22), `puddle` (weight 0.15); 3 individuals in a reference drop at weight 1.
<!-- /GENERATED -->

A [filament](../../mechanics/stalks-and-colonies.md#filaments) with the `helical_ribbon` style;
[scalariform conjugation](../../mechanics/stalks-and-colonies.md#filaments) when N limits (distance and times
estimated). Prey of *Vampyrella*.

## Not implemented yet

- The zygospore does not germinate.
- Genus-level being without a measured µmax.

## Unique and shared mechanics

The only being with scalariform conjugation; shares filaments with *Zygnema*, *Mougeotia*,
*Oedogonium* and *Ulothrix*.
